name: Triggs Memorial Golf Course
architects: Donald Ross (1933 on the club's card; the City of Providence gives 1932 as the opening year)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM, project RI_Statewide_D22 (2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide, QL1, flown March 2022), tile x29y464; NAD83 / UTM 19N (EPSG:26919), NAVD88 metres; downloaded by the developer 2026-10-20 (GitHub release data-triggs), clipped to the world + 100 m with pipeline/clip_raster.py

laz.source: 2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide (project RI_Statewide_D22), QL1, flown 30 March 2022 (leaf-off, from the points' GPS times); NOAA Data Access Viewer job J1473603 (dataset 9981), clipped to the world + ~200 m, classes 1 and 2 only, delivered in NAD83(2011) / Rhode Island (EPSG:6567) metres, NAVD88 metres; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures; the project has no vegetation classes); GitHub release data-triggs
laz.label: 2022 USGS RI statewide lidar, leaf-off

roof_note: s05: as at Wannamoisett (same lidar project), crowns whose returns are >= 85 % last returns are roofs of houses OSM doesn't map; to be checked on this course's per-crown last-return share before trusting it

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (887 x 1,033 m, way 43150786) + scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred: 1,280 m east-west (~197 m each side), 1,280 m north-south (~123 m each side)

scorecard_source: The club's printed scorecard (images Triggs-Scorecard-Front.png / Triggs-ScoreCard-Back.png from triggs.us, 2021 upload, release data-triggs, retrieved 2026-10-20): Blue 6,588 72.3/132, White 6,327 71.1/128, Gold 5,499 66.1/124, Red 5,374 71.3/124; pars 35-37 = 72; Blue/White, Gold and Red stroke indexes. Every row adds up to its printed total. The OSM hole tags (dist, par, handicap) match the Blue column on every hole. The club website's course page gives other ratings (Blue 71.5/129, White 70.5/126, Red 72/124); the printed card is used. 1golf.eu's older totals (Black 6,522, White 6,302, Red 5,392) are not used.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (2022 USGS Lidar: RI Statewide)
notes: Phase 1 (2026-10-20): standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1): Blue only, every penalty area red, OSM boundary is OB, range OB, pins at green centres, trees from lidar, wind 1-9 mph (inland New England). Theme seekonk (developer, 2026-10-20).
